column3: Visual memory meter moves into fengari via bun patch (patches/fengari@0.1.5.patch): luaL_prepbuffsize, luaV_concat, TString and ltable add call L.l_G.meter; the DO check meters its whole lifetime; xpcall handlers are skipped once the meter trips; shaders refuse loop macros, ## and line continuations, comments are blanked before the guard, and the guard drops to 1024 steps
column4: XIN-23 second review of #71: the global Uint8Array/Map swap missed copies made through Uint8Array.from, which defs.js binds at load; per-call reset let 24 handlers keep 778 MB inside one check; a hook-raised error runs the xpcall handler with hooks off; #define and comments dodged the text rewrite. A hook inside fengari is the only accounting point that sees every allocation, and keying it on the state's l_G avoids module-instance identity
